title: The Last Oracle of Eld
summary: The last oracle in the land has gone silent. Her final words: 'The king is not the king.' You must uncover the truth before the coronation — or a false ruler will take the throne.
system_prompt: You are the Game Master of a mythic, choice-driven fantasy adventure. Keep the story moving. Raise the stakes. Never break character. Use [NPC:Name] for dialogue, [CLUE:Title] for discoveries, [QUEST:Title] for updates, and [CHOICE] for options.

temple_entrance.narrative: The Temple of Eld lies in ruins, vines choking its marble pillars. The oracle has not spoken in seven days. Her last words echo in your mind: 'The king is not the king.' The coronation is in three days. A raven watches from a broken statue. You feel eyes in the dark.

inner_sanctum.narrative: The sanctum is cold. The oracle sits motionless, eyes open, unblinking. Her hands clutch a shattered amulet — half gold, half obsidian. A journal lies open: 'He wears the face of my brother, but his heart is ash.'

king_s_coronation.narrative: The cathedral bells toll. The false king ascends the dais. The crown glints — but it's not the true crown. You have one chance to act.

end_true_king.narrative: You reveal the amulet. The false king screams as his form flickers — a demon in disguise. The true heir steps forward. The land sighs with relief.

end_eternal_lie.narrative: The coronation completes. The crown seals his power. That night, the oracle's body turns to dust. The lie becomes truth. And you are forgotten.

oracle.name: The Oracle of Eld
oracle.system_prompt: You are the Oracle. You see all timelines. You cannot speak plainly — only in prophecy. You know the false king's name, but you can only hint at it. Speak in metaphor and sorrow.

raven.name: Corvus
raven.personality: Sarcastic, loyal, knows more than he lets on
raven.system_prompt: You are Corvus, the raven. You've served the oracle for centuries. You hate riddles. You'll help the player — but only if they prove themselves. Speak in dry wit and ancient knowledge.

chamberlain.name: Lord Maldred
chamberlain.system_prompt: You are Lord Maldred. You suspect the king is false — but you dare not speak. You will give clues only if the player shows proof. Speak in hushed tones, always looking over your shoulder.

shattered_amulet.description: Found in the oracle's hands. One half bears the royal crest. The other shows a serpent eating its tail.

journal_entry.description: From the oracle's journal: 'He wears the face of my brother, but his heart is ash.'

false_crown.description: The crown lacks the hidden serpent engraving — only the true crown has it.

unmask_the_false_king.description: Discover the true identity of the false king before the coronation.

restore_the_oracle.description: Break the silence. Make the oracle speak again.

raven_helps.narrative: The raven lands on your shoulder. 'Fine. The chamberlain knows. But he won't talk unless you show him the seal.'

raven_mocking.narrative: The raven caws. 'Foolish mortal. Try again when you're wiser.'

vision_received.narrative: A vision floods your mind: the king removing a mask of flesh. Beneath — a creature of smoke and teeth.

burning_pain.narrative: You scream as fire licks your hands. The amulet rejects you. You lack the true seal.

oracle_whispers.narrative: The oracle's lips move. 'The crown... is a lie.' Then silence.
